description: Improve both dashboards (/client/home and /coach/home) with real Supabase data for StatCards, new widgets, and better UX. Client gets: real verified-coach count, pending bookings count, Messages quick-link, error state. Coach gets: real client count, Today's Schedule card, Pending Requests card with links to /coach/appointments, appointment status filter tabs. Uses existing Card, StatCard, EmptyState, Badge, Button components. No new components needed. FEAT-001 must be complete before this (independent of it, but listed after for logical ordering).
steps: Update app/(client)/client/home/page.tsx — data layer: add state vars verifiedCoachCount (number, default 0) and pendingCount (number, default 0) and error (string|null). In loadDashboardData: (a) fetch real verified coach count with supabase.from('profiles').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('role', 'coach').eq('account_verified', true) and set verifiedCoachCount. (b) fetch pending bookings count with supabase.from('appointments').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('client_id', authUser.id).eq('status', 'pending') and set pendingCount. (c) add .gte('date', new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)) to the appointments query so only future/today sessions are fetched. (d) wrap the entire try block in try/catch and set error on catch.

Update app/(client)/client/home/page.tsx — StatCard row: replace the 4 existing StatCards with: (1) 'Upcoming Sessions' value={upcomingAppointments.length} description='Scheduled future appointments'. (2) 'Pending Bookings' value={pendingCount} description='Awaiting confirmation' icon=Clock. (3) 'Verified Coaches' value={verifiedCoachCount} description='Verified in your region'. (4) 'Account Status' keep as-is.

Update app/(client)/client/home/page.tsx — PageHeader action: add <Link href='/messages'> with MessageSquare icon and label 'Messages' alongside the existing Browse Coaches link. Import MessageSquare from lucide-react.

Update app/(client)/client/home/page.tsx — error state: if error is non-null after loading, show a <div> with error message and a Retry button that calls loadDashboardData. Import FormError from @/components/ui/FormError or use a simple inline div with the error classes from existing usage.

Update app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx — data layer: add state vars clientCount (number, default 0), pendingAppointments (Appointment[], default []), todayAppointments (Appointment[], default []). In fetchData: (a) fetch real client count with supabase.from('profiles').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('role', 'client') → setClientCount. (b) fetch pending requests: supabase.from('appointments').select('*, client:client_id(*)').eq('coach_id', profile.id).eq('status', 'pending').order('date', { ascending: true }).limit(5) → setPendingAppointments. (c) fetch today's schedule: supabase.from('appointments').select('*, client:client_id(*)').eq('coach_id', profile.id).eq('date', new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)).order('start_time', { ascending: true }) → setTodayAppointments.

Update app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx — StatCard row: replace 4 StatCards with: (1) 'Upcoming Appointments' value from appointments filtered to future dates with status confirmed or pending. (2) 'Registered Performers' value={clientCount} description='Local performers on platform'. (3) 'Platform Region' keep. (4) 'Coach Status' keep.

Update app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx — add 'Today's Schedule' card at the top of the main (lg:col-span-2) column. Use Card with CardHeader (icon=CalendarIcon, title='Today's Schedule'). If todayAppointments.length === 0 show compact EmptyState with title='No sessions today' and description='Your schedule is clear for today'. If todayAppointments.length > 0 show list of sessions with start_time, client name, session_type, and Badge for status.

Update app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx — add 'Pending Requests' card below Today's Schedule. Card with CardHeader (title='Pending Requests', action=Link to /coach/appointments 'View all'). List pendingAppointments with client name, date, time, and a <Link href='/coach/appointments' className='...'>Review</Link> button. If empty show compact EmptyState 'No pending requests'.

Update app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx — appointment status filter: above the existing 'Recent Appointment Requests' list, add 3 filter buttons: 'All', 'Pending', 'Confirmed'. Local state activeFilter (default 'all'). Filter the displayed appointments from the existing appointments state. No new DB queries needed.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
Client dashboard StatCard 'Verified Coaches' shows a DB-counted number (not recommendedCoaches.length capped at 8)
Client dashboard StatCard 'Pending Bookings' shows real pending appointment count
Client dashboard PageHeader has a Messages link button
Client dashboard shows error state if data loading fails
Client upcoming sessions list only shows appointments on or after today
Coach dashboard StatCard 'Registered Performers' shows real DB count (not recommendedUsers.length capped at 8)
Coach dashboard has a Today's Schedule card showing today's appointments or a clear empty state
Coach dashboard has a Pending Requests card showing pending appointments with links to /coach/appointments
Coach dashboard Recent Appointments has All/Pending/Confirmed filter tabs
